📖 How to use

      
  1. Pick a spinner style (ring, dots, bars, dual-ring).
  2. Adjust the size, color and animation speed.
  3. Preview the spinner live on the page.
  4. Click "Copy HTML + CSS" and paste the snippet where you need a loader.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
Does the spinner need JavaScript to animate?
Yes. The output is a single <div> plus a <style> block with pure CSS — no JavaScript or images needed.
Can I use multiple spinners on one page?
The snippet is self-contained, so paste it into any page and the spinner will animate wherever you place the div.
Does it work in React or Tailwind projects?
Only if your project uses CSS-in-JS. The generated code is plain CSS and works best in a <style> tag or stylesheet.
